entities.summary: Juan Francisco Antonio Hilarión Zea Díaz was a Neogranadine journalist, botanist, diplomat, politician, and statesman who served as Vice President of Gran Colombia under then President Simón Bolívar. He was also Ambassador of Gran Colombia to the United Kingdom where he tried in vain to gain recognition for the nascent nation of Gran Colombia.
